title: hieracium wiesbaurianum subsp. subcinereum
intro: Hieracium wiesbaurianum subsp. subcinereum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent, making it useful in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium wiesbaurianum subsp. subcinereum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other organic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
